releases.notes: OTA size optimization: store the existing Studio only as gzip. Reclaims 192 KiB, 25% OTA space free, same UI and unchanged gameplay, radio, profile format and partition layout. Modern gzip-capable browser required for local Studio; APIs unchanged. Signature, compression and browser/mock tests passed; physical testing pending. Dev19 retained.

Profile-centered navigation: direct QuadSlot replacement, shared editing selector, assign from profile details, immediate confirmed activation and stock selection. Unsaved edits protected by explicit choices. No radio, gameplay, storage format or RP2040 changes. Signed build and browser/schema2/3/4 mock tests passed; physical testing pending. Dev18 retained.

Experimental MeatVault Online: download curated profiles, validate integrity, review and explicitly save. First profile Halo 2 Bumper Jumper. Dev17 radio, gameplay, profile storage and RP2040 unchanged. Signed build and browser/schema2/3/4 simulated tests passed. Physical import and gameplay testing pending. Dev17 retained.

Experimental network stability test: 15s home Wi-Fi reconnect grace before fallback, reduced recovery scanning and status traffic, compressed configuration page, Wi-Fi fallback/reason reporting, corrected Bluetooth transport identification and deferred Wi-Fi entry rumble. No RP2040, profile storage or gameplay processing changes. Signed build and browser/mock tests passed; physical network recovery pending. Dev16 retained.

Experimental hardware test: QuadSlot LB+RB hold 600ms then D-pad, boot stock and repeat slot to return stock, numbered LED/haptic feedback and Wi-Fi cues, hidden stock with 12 assignable library positions, transport-specific SignalScope, compact tuning and fictional premium Easter egg. Preserves old profile storage and custom IDs, clears old stock slot assignment. Export profiles before upgrading. Host and mock tests passed; actual rumble, switching and NVS pending. RP2040 untouched; dev15 retained.

Experimental UI and telemetry refinement: single SignalScope panel, real SSID, uptime, minimum free heap, session report count and last-report age; compact Settings, direct Update, network mode cards and About. Removed unsupported thermal/power placeholders. Profile schema and gameplay processing unchanged. RP2040 untouched. Signed build and browser/mock tests passed; hardware measurements pending. Dev14 retained for recovery.

EXPERIMENTAL hardware-test build: final Controller Studio interface, Advanced Mapping, independent tuning groups, X/Y gain and radial geometry, directional MeatVault, SignalScope measured diagnostics, Settings/MeatLink. Migrates saved profiles into schema3 and retains dev13 storage for downgrade. Export important profiles before upgrading. Signed build and host/browser tests passed; real hardware testing pending. RP2040 unchanged. Dev13 remains recovery option.

EXPERIMENTAL Hambone Studio redesign: framed application, horizontal panes, three SVG controller skins, focused tuning, portable profiles, and existing network/OTA tools. Mock browser tests and signed build passed. Physical testing pending. No gameplay processing, RP2040, Bluetooth or profile storage changes. Dev.12 is the owner-tested recovery checkpoint.

EXPERIMENTAL: shared Hambone Controller Studio, independent stick/trigger/rumble tuning layers, portable v2 profiles and graph previews. Build and simulated storage/browser tests passed; physical hardware testing pending. Retains dev.11 profile storage for downgrade.
Owner-tested installation: named profiles, dual-skin two-tap visual remapper and simple local hostname. Recovery checkpoint before Controller Studio.
Hardware-tested development build: mobile layout, saved home Wi-Fi preference with direct AP fallback, successful local OTA.
Hardware-tested recovery build: stop controller discovery after pairing; reliable AP and remapping.
